correctness.rationale: For the explicit 20-edge 11-vertex Mycielski graph, independently enumerated all 12480 proper labelled 4-colour states via pentagon/apex/shadow constraints; built all 45240 legal one-vertex recolour edges. Components have 6240 vertices each, and symmetry action S4 x D5 has 56 orbits (48 size 240, 8 size 120). One exact BFS per orbit determines all source eccentricities and pair distances, giving radius15, diameter17, global eccentricities 15:2160,16:10200,17:120 and 60 diametral unordered pairs. Exactly one 120-element orbit is peripheral, and each member has one antipode. This is exhaustive finite proof, not extrapolation to other graphs or palettes.
